expectation: CDX2 is a nuclear transcription factor. A working stain should light the nuclei of intestinal epithelial cells (enterocytes, goblet cells) in a lining of crypts and villi, with stromal and lymphoid cells negative.
observed: A: yellow haze over the whole tissue, including stroma, with stripes and tiles on the right-hand piece. B, C: diffuse haze and a glowing rim around a lumen, not discrete nuclei. D: irregular yellow blobs between the blue nuclei. E: haze and speckle, mostly not on the Ecadherin cells.
why: The signal is diffuse haze that follows tissue and has stripe artefacts, with no distinct nuclear epithelial population and no co-localisation with Ecadherin.
